'''Cathar Warstaffs''' were fashioned by the feline [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] and were used during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]].<ref name="Cartel Market" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cathar Warstaffs first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the Cartel Market.<ref name="Cartel Market" />
